item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las lha btsan dar ma'i zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ yi ger btab pa bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams mchog nam mkhas khyab tshad bon nyid dbyings/ 'du 'bral med par ye rdzogs smon/ kha ba can ljongs bod yul dbus/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas mchog mkha' la yongs khyab nyi shar shog/
